title.narrative: Support to Strengthening the Capacities of the Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre, Maritime Safety and Security and Law Enforcement to Counter Maritime Crime in Maldives

description.narrative: The Global Maritime Crime Programme (GMCP) of the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) supports Member States in strengthening its capacities in enhancing and coordinating their efforts against maritime crime. GMCP has \nbeen engaging full-time experts in Bangladesh, Maldives and Sri Lanka to strengthen the capabilities of law enforcement agencies and criminal justice actors to prevent, detect, investigate and prosecute maritime crime offences. In addition to the delivery of training and mentoring programmes, UNODC GMCP also provides specialized equipment to law enforcement agencies, such as communications, navigational, security and boat maintenance equipment, to contribute to their overall operational and training capabilities to better tackle maritime crime.\n
